onboarding.default_transcript:
Welcome to SeniorPadi. It's for people aged 60 and over in Ibadan.

Finding something to do: tap Events. You'll see what's happening this week, and later. Tap an event to read more.

Joining: tap Register. We'll send you a text to confirm, and another text before the day. On the day, just come. Your name will be on the list.

Can't make it? Go to My places and cancel, so someone else can have your place.

Helping out: some events need volunteers. Look for the green Volunteer button.

Meeting people: in Find Seniors you can chat with other seniors. For everyone's safety, we check an ID first. If anyone makes you uncomfortable, tap Report a problem.

If a family member is helping you, that's fine. Welcome, and enjoy.

about.title: About us
about.intro: SeniorPadi helps people aged 60 and over in Ibadan stay active, learn new things and make friends.
about.why_text: Many older people spend a lot of time alone. There are good events in Ibadan, but they're hard to find. We bring them together in one simple place, in English and Yorùbá.
about.how_1: Churches, clubs and community centres share their events with us.
about.how_2: Seniors register or volunteer, and get a text with their ticket number.
about.how_3: Our staff check everyone in on the day.
about.safety_text: We check an ID before anyone can meet other seniors, and you can block or report anyone at any time. We will never ask you for money.
about.contact_text: Call us for help with your account, questions, or to list an event for your church, club or centre.

home.quote_1: Aging is not lost youth but a *new stage of opportunity and strength*.
home.quote_2: Grow old along with me! *The best is yet to be.*
home.quote_3: Aging is an extraordinary process where you become *the person you always should have been*.
home.quote_4: Do not regret growing older. It is *a privilege* denied to many.
home.quote_5: The longer I live, *the more beautiful life becomes*.
home.quote_6: Know that you are *the perfect age*. Each year is special and precious, for you shall only live it once. Be comfortable with growing older.
home.quote_7: You don’t stop laughing when you grow old, you grow old when you *stop laughing*.
home.quote_8: I believe the second half of one’s life is meant to be better than the first half. The first half is finding out how you do it. And the second half is *enjoying it*.
home.why_language: Read everything in the language you are most comfortable with.
home.why_safe: Staff check every member’s ID before they can message others.
home.why_help: Help is a phone call away
home.why_help_text: Call us if you get stuck, and we will help you.
home.ready_title: There is a place for you here
home.ready_text: Join the SeniorPadi community. All you need is your phone number.
about.promise_text: A friendly, safe place to find things to do, and people to do them with, close to home.
about.why_more1: Families are busy, friends move away, and it is easy to stay at home all week. But staying active and connected makes later life richer.
about.why_more2: So we built a simple website made for seniors: big text, few buttons, and help is a phone call away.
about.mission_text: To reduce social isolation among older adults by connecting them with community events, meaningful relationships, and organizations committed to promoting active ageing.
about.value_respect_text: We treat every senior with dignity and patience.
about.value_inclusion_text: English and Yorùbá, large text, and help by phone, so no one is left out.
about.value_friendship_text: Padi means friend. Everything we do brings people together.
about.partners_text: Churches, clubs and community centres across Ibadan share their events with us. Our staff list them, check everyone in on the day, and are always a phone call away.
about.lead: SeniorPadi brings older adults, community organizations, and volunteers together to create opportunities for connection, friendship, and active ageing.
about.problem_title: Growing Older Shouldn’t Mean Growing Apart.
about.problem_p1: As people grow older, opportunities to socialize, make new friends, and participate in community activities can become limited. Some seniors spend long periods without meaningful social interaction, while others simply need more opportunities to get out, explore their interests, and connect with people around them.
about.problem_p2: SeniorPadi exists to help change that.
about.problem_p3: We believe older adults deserve opportunities to stay involved, discover new experiences, build friendships, and remain active members of their communities.
about.vision_text: A society where every senior feels valued, included, connected, and able to enjoy a fulfilling life.
about.do_text: SeniorPadi makes it easier for seniors and the people who care about their wellbeing to discover and create meaningful community experiences.
about.do1_text: Find activities, gatherings, and experiences that make it easier to meet people, explore interests, and enjoy time in the community.
about.do2_text: We bring seniors together with churches, schools, gyms, businesses, NGOs, and community groups interested in creating inclusive experiences.
about.do3_text: We create opportunities for older adults to meet new people, develop friendships, and feel more connected to the people around them.
about.do4_text: We welcome volunteers, supporters, and organizations who want to contribute their time, skills, resources, or ideas to community experiences for seniors.
about.works_text: Creating opportunities for seniors to connect is easier when people and organizations work together.
about.step1_text: Community organizations identify activities, gatherings, and experiences that older adults can participate in.
about.step2_text: Seniors can explore available events, find activities that interest them, and learn where and when they take place.
about.step3_text: Through shared experiences, older adults have more opportunities to socialize, participate, and develop meaningful connections.
about.partner_p1: We believe creating inclusive communities for older adults is a shared responsibility. That is why SeniorPadi welcomes collaboration with organizations that want to make their activities and events more accessible to seniors.
about.partner_p2: From church gatherings and school-led intergenerational activities to fitness sessions, creative workshops, educational events, and community outings, partnerships can help create experiences that bring different generations together.
about.partner_note: Organizations we would love to work with
about.val_dignity_text: Every senior deserves to be treated with respect and recognized for their individuality.
about.val_belonging_text: Everyone deserves opportunities to connect, participate, and feel part of a community.
about.val_inclusion_text: Community experiences should welcome older adults with different interests, abilities, and backgrounds.
about.val_collab_text: Working together helps create more meaningful opportunities for seniors.
about.final_title: Let’s Make Room for More Connection.
about.final_text: Whether you’re looking for new experiences, organizing community activities, or hoping to make a difference, there is a place for you in the SeniorPadi community.
about.tagline: SeniorPadi. Because belonging has no age limit.
